STATE OF FLORIDA,
Plaintiff,

v.

JONATHAN PETRI,
Defendant.
JUDGE: HON. DOE
CASE NO: C5601
DATE: October 15, 2024

WITNESS STATEMENT
Witness: MARTHA WILSON
ID: W001

I, Martha Wilson, being duly sworn, do state under penalty of perjury as follows:

On September 12, 2024, I witnessed the defendant initiating the confrontation with the victim in the parking lot of Garcia's Restaurant. The defendant approached the victim from behind and made threatening gestures. The bystander description matched the defendant from the prior incident. The witness identified the defendant based on physical characteristics including height and distinctive gold chain. The confrontation was observed for approximately three minutes before the defendant fled the scene.

Signature of Witness: Martha Wilson
Date: October 10, 2024

WITNESS STATEMENT (ATTORNEY-ONLY - DO NOT CIRCULATE EXTERNA LLC)
Witness: ADRIAN CARMEN
ID: W003

I, Adrian Carmen, being duly sworn, do state under penalty of perjury as follows:

My client, Ms. Elena Rodriguez, engaged me as legal counsel in early 2023 for a separate legal matter involving property disputes in Jacksonville. In June 2023, my client mentioned her brother Jonathan Petri had been involved in a traffic incident in Palms. Attorney client privilege and confidential communications apply. The brother mentioned driving a 2018 silver pickup truck with customized wheels. Our client has never been in contact with the defendant since that initial reference in 2023. This current case involves Ms. Carmen's confession witness and client in connection with the September 12 incident.

Signature of Counsel: Adrian Carmen, Esq.
Law Firm: Carmen & Associates
Date: September 28, 2024

STATE OF FLORIDA
COUNTY OF MIAMI-DADE

STATE OF FLORIDA,
Plaintiff,

v.

JONATHAN PETRI,
Defendant.
JUDGE: HON. DOE
CASE NO: C5601
DATE: October 15, 2024

WITNESS STATEMENT
Witness: ROBERT GARCIA
ID: W002

I, Robert Garcia, being duly sworn, do state under penalty of perjury as follows:

On the afternoon of September 12, 2024, I was serving as the parking lot security guard at Garcia's Restaurant. At approximately 4:30 PM, I observed the defendant engage with the victim. The defendant appeared agitated and the confrontation escalated quickly. My badge number is SG-442 and in my position I have a clear view of the restaurant premises. The defendant was approximately 6 feet tall, had curly hair, and was wearing a distinctive gold chain. I called 911 within an hour of the incident which took me on leave the following day to shore up any injuries I sustained while observing the confrontation. Water from drinking fountain on scene is evidence I was present.

Signature of Witness: Robert Garcia
Date: October 8, 2024
